name: RetroStudio Lua Extensions
description: Lua extension library for RetroStudio game development

categories.name: Sprite
categories.description: Sprite creation, animation, and transform functions

functions.name: Create
functions.description: Create a sprite instance by asset name (loads .d2s/.d2f from build)

functions.name: Destroy
functions.description: Remove a sprite from the scene

functions.name: Clone
functions.description: Deep-clone a sprite instance and return a new handle

functions.name: SetPaletteSlot
functions.description: Set which palette slot this sprite uses

functions.name: SetAttributes
functions.description: Set sprite attribute flags (mirror, repeat, etc.)

functions.name: SetAnimation
functions.description: Set the active animation by name (does not auto-play)

functions.name: Play
functions.description: Start native auto-animation (ticked by engine, no Lua calls needed per frame)

parameters.name: animName
parameters.description: Animation name (optional, uses current if omitted)

functions.name: Stop
functions.description: Stop native auto-animation (freeze on current frame)

functions.name: UpdateAnimation
functions.description: Manual animation tick (for frame-level control from Lua)

categories.name: Image
categories.description: Image creation, transform, and frame selection functions

functions.name: Create
functions.description: Create an image instance by asset name (loads .d2 from build)

functions.name: Destroy
functions.description: Remove an image from the scene

functions.name: Clone
functions.description: Clone an image instance and return a new handle

functions.name: SetPaletteSlot
functions.description: Set which palette slot this image uses

functions.name: SetAttributes
functions.description: Set image attribute flags (mirror, repeat, etc.)

functions.name: SetFrame
functions.description: Set active frame index for a multi-frame image

functions.name: GetFrameCount
functions.description: Get number of frames available on the image

functions.name: Create
functions.description: Create a textbox instance bound to a font asset

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique textbox name (used to reference it later)

parameters.name: fontName
parameters.description: Font asset name (matches .fnt filename without extension)

functions.name: Destroy
functions.description: Remove a textbox from the scene

functions.name: SetText
functions.description: Set the text content of a textbox

functions.name: GetText
functions.description: Get the text content of a textbox

functions.name: SetPaletteSlot
functions.description: Set which palette slot this textbox uses

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: Resource ID (use MUSIC constants like MUSIC.SONG_1)

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: Whether to loop the music (optional, default: true)

returns.description: True if music started playing successfully
True if music was stopped successfully

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: Resource ID (use SFX constants like SFX.COOL)

returns.description: True if sound started playing successfully
True if sound was stopped successfully

functions.name: IsPlaying
functions.description: Check if a sound effect is currently playing

returns.description: True if sound is currently playing

functions.name: SetVolume
functions.description: Set volume for a sound effect resource

returns.description: True if volume was set successfully

functions.name: List
functions.description: List all available SFX resources (for debugging)

functions.name: GetKeysHeld
functions.description: Returns a bit array of keys currently held

returns.description: Bit array of currently held keys

functions.name: GetKeysPressed
functions.description: Returns the keys pressed since last update

returns.description: Bit array of keys pressed this frame

functions.name: GetKeysReleased
functions.description: Returns the keys released since last update

returns.description: Bit array of keys released this frame

functions.name: IsKeyHeld
functions.description: Returns true if the key is held

returns.description: True if key is currently held

functions.name: IsKeyPressed
functions.description: Returns true if the key was pressed this frame

returns.description: True if key was pressed this frame

functions.name: IsKeyReleased
functions.description: Returns true if the key was released this frame

returns.description: True if key was released this frame

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Number to take square root of

functions.name: Pow
functions.description: Power function - raise x to the power of y

returns.description: x raised to the power of y

functions.name: Min
functions.description: Returns the minimum of two values

functions.name: Max
functions.description: Returns the maximum of two values

functions.name: Clamp
functions.description: Clamps x to min and max inclusive

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Value to get absolute value of

functions.name: Random
functions.description: Random integer between x (inclusive) and y (exclusive)

functions.name: HoursToDegrees
functions.description: Returns the angle corresponding to the current time for positioning a watch hand

returns.description: Angle in degrees for hour hand

functions.name: MinutesToDegrees
functions.description: Returns the angle corresponding to the current minutes for positioning a watch hand

returns.description: Angle in degrees for minute hand

functions.name: SecondsToDegrees
functions.description: Returns the angle corresponding to the current seconds for positioning a watch hand

returns.description: Angle in degrees for second hand

functions.name: Day
functions.description: Returns the day of the month

functions.name: DayOfWeek
functions.description: Gets the string representation of the day of the week

functions.name: ToString
functions.description: Format time using standard C time library format string

functions.name: LogLua
functions.description: Log a message to the console from Lua
